title: Early Detection of Ovarian Cancer Using GAN-Based Data Augmentation and Transformer Models
summary: A PhD research pipeline for early cancer detection from biomarker data, combining synthetic tabular data augmentation with logistic-regression feature selection and a SAINT transformer classifier, validated across ovarian, breast, and lung cancer datasets. It fits SDV's GaussianCopulaSynthesizer and CTGANSynthesizer (with SingleTableMetadata) directly and runs SDV's evaluate_quality/run_diagnostic functions to generate and validate the synthetic biomarker data used for augmentation.
